However, in Christian communities, particularly among the Ultra-Orthodox Jewish diaspora, there have been reports of Christians adopting this term to signify their own deep commitment to their faith and obedience to God's commands. This use of the term is a testament to the cultural exchange and cross-fertilization that occurs within global religious communities.
